resources.string: Sends taps and swipes produced by the GameAgent companion app

GameAgent uses this service only to deliver taps and swipes that its own decision pipeline has produced and validated. Enable it only if you want the companion app to be able to interact with other apps\u0027 screens. The service never reads on-screen text and never inspects other apps\u0027 content.
Shown while GameAgent is capturing the screen
GameAgent is capturing the screen. Tap to open the dashboard.
